Activities.metaTitle: Things to do with kids, near you · Hale
Activities.metaDescription: Low-cost and no-cost activities for babies, toddlers, and young kids — library story-times, drop-in play, parent-and-tot swim, parks, and local family programs.

Answers.metaDescription: Calm, cited parenting guides for the questions families search for — general guidance grounded in trusted frameworks, never a substitute for your provider.
Answers.empty: Parenting guides are in review. In the meantime, the fastest way to get guidance for your own child — with their age and your family in mind — is to ask Hale.

AnswerArticle.guidanceNote: General guidance, last reviewed {date, date, long} — not medical advice.
AnswerArticle.sourcesLede: Every claim on this page is attributed to one of the parenting-health frameworks Hale draws from. Follow a source to its publisher; the books are named rather than linked.
AnswerArticle.disclaimerHeading: This is general guidance, not medical advice.
AnswerArticle.disclaimerBody: Hale summarizes widely recommended, cited parenting-health guidance. It cannot see your child, and it does not diagnose, prescribe, or interpret symptoms. For anything about your child’s health — including diagnosis, dosing, or symptoms — talk to your pediatrician or health provider. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.
